reviewer: Separate AI normative reviewer; no human reviewer
methodology: Read every query in the shuffled blind packet, plus its source-only rules, capabilities, and schema.
Independently assigned all decisions from source semantics; source patterns only automate transcription of already reviewed clauses.
No candidate code, tests, results, labels, historical corpora, sealed data, remote inference, network, or Mongo access.
Known absence uses explicit native defaults and APPLICABLE_ABSENCE; missing/ambiguous operands retain UNRESOLVED; unsupported projections retain source assertions.
Source-only optional notice accepts E/EWN for advisory/governance-only cases; actual corrections require EWN.
Received source-only format clarification: formats conjunctive; BOTH equivalent to ONLINE+PHYSICAL; exclusive_formats is a separate list for source ONLY choices. This supplied no candidate outcomes.
Output files are created exclusively and never overwritten.
uncertainties: Blocked equalities, disjunctions, unavailable joins, and metadata operations are preserved verbatim in unadapted mandatory assertions; no lossy scalar oracle is invented.
Optional preferences are structured source-backed descriptions; exact scalar/string equivalence is excluded.
